description: Oil and Gas Resources of Australia is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This publication is the sucessor to Oil and Gas Resources 1999 and continues as the definitive reference on exploration, development and production of Australia's petroleum resources. It covers exploration, reserves, undiscovered resources, development, production and supporting information and statistics. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU, Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Other Publication, Published_External. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
